summary: Nothing in the fundamentals changed today. The menu is still dated 2026-11-17, and every held single stock is on it with the same F-scores and CFO and net-income figures as this morning. No lesson in learning.json names the fundamentals-analyst, and I have no graded calls, so no lesson shaped this review.

update: For the next run: (1) The fundamentals give no reason to defend VOO or VTI. Both their clauses are met, and the Proposer owes the combined sale. (2) FAST is the PM's named sell candidate. Its fundamentals are unchanged (F7, gp_sector_pct 0.934, CFO $884.3M vs NI $782.6M), and the annual data predates the Q3 print. If the stop trips, that is a price exit, not a fundamentals one.
